# Budget stress matrix — svelte corpus repo (large: ~4k surface candidates, raw surface ~52k tokens)

Wave 15.1b verification of the required-coverage budget blowout fix.
The reviewer's stress case: a repo where raw candidate surface >> 24k tokens.
Before the fix: identical ~52k-token output at every budget (all entries
required via public_api surfaces, never dropped).
After the fix: concrete invocation surfaces only are critical coverage;
required set capped at hard_max; the ranker decides plain exports' fate.

budget   artifact tokens   notes
4000     ~4452            required items past soft target, under hard_max 4800 (documented soft/hard)
16000    ~12666           monotonic curve
24000    ~17011           still under budget: pool exhausted by value/token + quotas/MMR

All artifacts fit the budget semantics: target may be exceeded only by
required critical coverage, never beyond hard_max (budget + 20%).
